entries.title: The frame
entries.note: The panel border, on its own transparent layer, 2731 x 1536, ready to lay over any frame. Every frame now ships edge to edge with no border drawn into it, and this is the border, so it can move, animate, breathe or come off entirely. It was not generated. It was cut out of an existing drawing, so it is the same hand and the same graphite as the artwork it goes over. The middle is completely empty: measured, not assumed, zero non transparent pixels anywhere inside the rectangle.

entries.title: The marathon runner
entries.note: The runner, four views: front, three quarter, profile and rear. Lean, about forty five, singlet and shorts, bib 27, worn racing shoes. This is who he is, and every frame of scene 1 is built from him. One thing to know: the sheet has no face at portrait size, so it holds the body and not the head. A face sheet is being made separately and will appear here beside this one.

The whole film as it stands, four panels to a page, with every line and every frame number. The live action frames now show the real footage from the shoot beside the drawn version, with the clip and the timecode on each. At the back there are two pages of clean footage frames, one per shot, for pulling into tests. This is not a proposal, it is the current version of the document. Superseded by v8. It is not deleted and the link still works, but v8 is the one to read.
